I replied in #strategic-pod: Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group.

His July 1 post first said 300. About five minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth confirmed 280. His correction doesn't name Vantorre, only "Nadia's old industrial account", so I read it as replacing the 300. The figure is as of July 1 and may have changed since.
